messages:
Nora (People Ops): FYI: Omar flagged that several interviewers didn't get their certification toggled in the scorecard UI after this morning's LMS webhook change. Can we triage?

Omar (Recruiting Ops): Yep, noticed on panel DS-2. Scorecards show 0 certified but LMS shows completion for 3 people.

Chen (Talent Systems): Looking at the payloads the LMS started sending: they renamed 'trainer_id' -> 'instructorId' and nested completions under 'results'. Our listener expects the flat shape.

lms-bot: Webhook received 2026-03-22T13:04:04Z status=200 id=wh_9bcd

Zoe (Hiring Manager): Is this going to block interviews? I have two panels this week that rely on certified interviewers.

Omar (Recruiting Ops): It won't cancel invites but auto-enable scoring is blocked. We can manually flip owners on the scorecards if needed.

Chen (Talent Systems): Short-term plan: make the webhook adapter accept both shapes and normalize. I'll open a tiny PR with a compatibility layer. Also will add a migration that backfills cert flags for panels created in the last 7 days.

ops-bot: Deploy queued: integrations/lms-compat -> staging. Triggered by Chen.

Nora (People Ops): Please run a dry-run of the backfill and paste the affected panels here so we can notify managers before any change.

Chen (Talent Systems): Dry-run output (summary): 7 panels affected: DS-2, ENG-12, ENG-15, PROD-3, DATA-5, OPS-1, SRE-7. Will DM full list + user IDs.

Omar (Recruiting Ops): I'll hold automated reminder emails until backfill completes to avoid duplicate notifications. If anyone needs manual enable now, ping me.

Nora (People Ops): Thanks. After the deploy and backfill, let's add a quick CI test asserting both 'results.completed' and 'completed' map to the same event shape. Also add the change to the recruitment runbook under "third-party webhook changes".
